title: How hot or cold is each thing?
prompt: Place each one from coldest to hottest.

items.label: A home freezer
items.fact: Home freezers are set to −18 °C to keep food safely frozen.

items.label: A freezing winter day
items.fact: Water freezes at 0 °C — the reference point of the Celsius scale.

items.label: Room temperature
items.fact: Most people find about 21 °C comfortable indoors.

items.label: Human body temperature
items.fact: The classic 98.6 °F figure is an average — normal ranges a degree either way.

items.label: Boiling water
items.fact: At sea level water boils at 100 °C; it drops at altitude.
